note: Offline sample. Outlets and stories are invented for testing; links go to example.com.

articles.title: Storm Elin batters western Norway, cutting power to 40,000 homes
articles.snippet: Gusts above 140 km/h brought down lines across Vestland overnight, and the grid operator says some valleys may be dark until Monday.

articles.title: Ferries cancelled and bridges closed as Storm Elin sweeps the Norwegian coast
articles.snippet: Coastal ferry routes north of Bergen were suspended and two suspension bridges closed to traffic as the storm moved inland.

articles.title: Storm Elin: power outages spread across Norway's west coast
articles.snippet: Tens of thousands of households lost electricity as the strongest autumn storm in a decade hit Vestland and Møre og Romsdal.

articles.title: Is Storm Elin a sign of things to come? Scientists weigh in on warmer seas
articles.snippet: Meteorologists say unusually warm North Sea temperatures gave the storm extra energy, though linking a single event to climate change is hard.

articles.title: Insurers brace for storm claims after Elin hits Norway
articles.snippet: Early estimates put insured damage from the storm in the hundreds of millions of kroner, with roofs, boats and cars worst hit.

articles.title: Swedish rail workers walk out in nationwide strike over pay
articles.snippet: Trains across Sweden stood still on Saturday morning as the rail union began a 48-hour strike after talks with operators broke down.

articles.title: Rail strike halts Swedish trains, stranding weekend travellers
articles.snippet: Commuters and tourists were left looking for buses as the rail strike shut down most services between Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö.

articles.title: Operators call Swedish rail strike 'irresponsible' as union demands inflation-linked raises
articles.snippet: Train companies say the union's pay demand would force fare increases; the union says members have lost real income for three years.

articles.title: Why Sweden's train drivers are striking, explained
articles.snippet: The dispute is about pay, shift lengths and staffing on night trains. Here's what each side wants and how long it could last.

articles.title: Chipmaker Halden Semiconductor beats forecasts on AI demand
articles.snippet: Quarterly revenue rose 38 percent as data-centre customers bought more of its accelerator chips, sending shares up in early trading.

articles.title: Halden Semiconductor shares jump after record quarter
articles.snippet: The chip designer reported record revenue and raised its full-year outlook, citing strong orders for AI servers.

articles.title: Halden's AI chip boom hides a weak consumer business, analysts warn
articles.snippet: Sales of chips for phones and laptops fell for a fourth quarter, leaving the company more dependent on a handful of cloud customers.

articles.title: Halden Semiconductor earnings: revenue surges on data-centre orders
articles.snippet: Results beat expectations on both revenue and profit; the company plans a new fabrication partnership in 2027.

articles.title: European lunar lander touches down near the Moon's south pole
articles.snippet: The robotic lander Selene-2 confirmed a soft landing on Saturday and sent back its first images of the cratered terrain.

articles.title: Selene-2 lands on the Moon in a first for the European Space Agency
articles.snippet: Mission control erupted in applause as the lander's signal confirmed it had survived the descent near Shackleton crater.

articles.title: Moon landing: what Selene-2 will look for in the lunar ice
articles.snippet: The lander carries a drill and a small lab to test whether water ice near the south pole could one day supply future crews.

articles.title: Critics question the cost of Europe's Moon lander after successful touchdown
articles.snippet: The Selene-2 mission ran two years late and over budget, and some lawmakers ask whether robotic landers are the best use of space funds.

articles.title: Oslo city council approves a higher congestion charge for petrol cars
articles.snippet: Drivers of petrol and diesel cars will pay more at rush hour from January, while electric cars keep a reduced rate.

articles.title: Oslo raises rush-hour road tolls in vote on congestion charge
articles.snippet: The council voted 32 to 27 for the new toll rates; opponents say the charge hits commuters from outside the city hardest.

articles.title: Business groups warn Oslo's new congestion charge will hurt city-centre shops
articles.snippet: Retailers say higher road tolls will push shoppers to malls outside the city, while the council expects cleaner air and fewer cars.

articles.title: Striker Marco Vidal completes record transfer to Bergen United
articles.snippet: The forward signed a four-year contract after the club agreed a fee believed to be the highest in the league's history.

articles.title: Bergen United smash transfer record to sign Marco Vidal
articles.snippet: Supporters gathered outside the stadium as the club unveiled its new striker, who scored 21 goals last season.

articles.title: Is Marco Vidal worth the record fee? The numbers behind the transfer
articles.snippet: Expected-goals data suggests the striker's finishing is elite, but injuries kept him out of a third of matches in two seasons.

articles.title: Pop star Lumi and actor Jonas Brekke marry in secret ceremony
articles.snippet: The couple wed in front of 40 guests at a lakeside chapel, according to people at the event.

articles.title: Lumi and Jonas Brekke wedding: inside the celebrity couple's lakeside ceremony
articles.snippet: Guests included musicians and film stars; the bride wore a dress by a young Copenhagen designer.

articles.title: National Museum reopens its design wing after two-year renovation
articles.snippet: The new galleries put Scandinavian furniture and posters from the 1950s next to work by young designers.

articles.title: Review: the new Aurora phone has the best screen we've tested this year
articles.snippet: Battery life is excellent and the camera is good in daylight, but the price makes it a hard sell against last year's model.

articles.title: Fermented foods are the year's biggest home cooking trend
articles.snippet: Sales of jars, airlocks and starter cultures doubled as home cooks turned to kimchi, kefir and sourdough.

articles.title: Wildfire in southern Spain forces evacuation of three villages
articles.snippet: Firefighters are fighting the blaze from the air as dry winds push it toward farmland near Ronda.

articles.title: Bitcoin slides below key level as traders take profits
articles.snippet: The cryptocurrency fell 6 percent in a day, dragging other digital tokens lower after a month-long rally.

articles.title: Study finds a daily walk cuts heart disease risk more than expected
articles.snippet: Researchers followed 60,000 adults for ten years and found 30 minutes of brisk walking lowered risk by a quarter.
